label: National governments and line ministries
plain: Fund national schemes such as clean-cooking subsidies and social protection.

label: National environment ministries and pollution boards
plain: Set standards, run national monitoring and programmes such as NCAP.

label: State pollution control boards and airshed commissions
plain: License and inspect polluters, enforce rules, run state monitoring (for example CAQM, state PCBs).

label: City and municipal governments
plain: Run waste, roads, construction rules and local clean-air plans.

label: Transport departments and operators
plain: Run bus fleets, inspection centres and vehicle rules.

label: Labour departments and welfare boards
plain: Register workers and pay compensation and benefits.

label: Health departments and hospitals
plain: Run surveillance, primary care and treatment.

label: Education departments and schools
plain: Decide closures, run schools and classroom measures.

label: Agriculture departments
plain: Run residue machinery and payment schemes.

label: Development banks and bilateral donors
plain: Lend and grant for public programmes.

label: Foundations
plain: Fund research, pilots, monitoring and community groups.

label: NGOs, worker and community organisations
plain: Organise, inform, represent affected groups, monitor locally.

label: Companies and social enterprises
plain: Supply technology, operate services, and in some cases emit.
